run_gmock_output_test: run the gmock output test to verify Google Mock text output matches the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file for gmock output test using the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize gmock test output by removing headers, footers, locations, and memory addresses
extract_leaky_tests: extract a list of test names that leak mock objects from gmock output
normalize_line_endings: convert Windows and Mac line endings to UNIX line endings in test output
